title: Corrosive Steam Wave
body:
Syntax: perform corrosive steam wave <target>

Description: A Boil Release attack that strikes one target. A weakened target deals 15% less damage.  Requires Boil Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 1509-1789. 35% chance to inflict weakened. Unlocks at level 70. Costs 78 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 24 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
